en.title: Delivery Lead
en.requirements:
What You'll Do

  • Join a team of AI-first engineers, designers, and leaders.

  • Lead the delivery of large-scale custom software projects, ensuring work stays on track across scope, timeline, and quality

  • Proactively identify delivery risks and clearly communicate tradeoffs and mitigation plans to clients and internal teams

  • Partner closely with clients, facilitating clear communication and acting as a trusted, strategic advisor throughout the project lifecycle

  • Plan ahead of the current sprint by shaping future work, dependencies, and priorities

  • Translate high-level goals into clear requirements, tasks, and delivery plans

  • Facilitate sprint planning, grooming, and ongoing pr
